$comment: Sample asset plan for the cost estimator. Run: python scripts/estimate_cost.py --plan templates/asset_plan.example.json. This example reflects a realistic 5-page agency client site (Viceroy Elderly Care Services) with a mix of paid raster generation, free SVG icons, and one decorative SVG.

$notes: regen_assumption=1.3 budgets for ~30% of raster generations needing one regeneration loop. For brand-strict clients this can climb to 1.5; for prototyping 1.1 is fine.
review_per_asset=true includes Claude vision review costs in the estimate. Set false if you intend to skip review and review the assets yourself.
